outcome_statement: A requireKey-gated route receives photo uploads from the Android gallery plugin and commits them into the repo via the existing commitManyToGitHub helper, so photos survive Railway's ephemeral filesystem.
pain: The gallery-read plugin can read photo bytes off the phone but has nowhere durable to send them -- a plain disk write on Railway vanishes on redeploy.
value: Card photos taken on the phone land directly in the repo for setting up listings, no manual transfer step.
success_metrics: A real POST with a test image returns ok:true and a real commit sha
The file is actually present in the repo at data/card-photos/<filename> afterward
failure_metrics: Photo bytes corrupted (non-binary-safe commit path used)
constraints: Must use commitManyToGitHub's existing binary-safe path, not a new commit mechanism
unacceptable_result: Any change beyond the single upload route
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision -- Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff -- corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
